headline: 3 arrested after body dumped on Elevated Expressway
summary: Police and RAB have arrested a bus driver, supervisor, and helper following the discovery of a man's body on the Dhaka Elevated Expressway.
details: Police and RAB have arrested three people, including a bus driver, in connection with the discovery of a body on the Dhaka Elevated Expressway in Banani.
The arrests were made during a joint operation in Mohakhali on Saturday, where a bus operating on the Dhaka-Jamalpur route was also seized.
The suspects include bus driver Sohel Rana (40), supervisor Saju (28), and helper Monir (18).
The victim has been identified as 50-year-old Ismail Hossain, a resident of Jamalpur who lived with his family in Gazipur's Kashimpur area.
The body was recovered on Friday morning from the expressway in the Banani area with scotch tape covering the mouth.
Ismail was wearing a blue shirt similar to the uniform of CNG auto-rickshaw drivers when his body was found.

headline: Tension at IU: Student league leader slaps Shibir leader, weapons seen on campus
summary: Clashes and weapon displays erupted at Islamic University following a physical altercation between leaders of Chhatra Dal and Islami Chhatra Shibir.
details: Tension gripped the Islamic University (IU) campus after a leader of Chhatra Dal allegedly slapped a leader of Islami Chhatra Shibir.
The incident sparked immediate unrest, leading to shoving and heated confrontations between the supporters of the two student wings.
Witnesses reported seeing students carrying weapons, including 'ramdas' (large cleavers), during the unrest on campus.
The situation created a volatile atmosphere as both groups gathered in numbers, increasing the risk of further violence.
University authorities and security are monitoring the situation to prevent the escalation of clashes between the rival political student groups.
caption:
A single slap sparks chaos at Islamic University. Weapons were seen on campus as rival student groups clashed.

Tension gripped the Islamic University (IU) campus after a leader of Chhatra Dal allegedly slapped a leader of Islami Chhatra Shibir.

The incident sparked immediate unrest, leading to shoving and heated confrontations between the supporters of the two student wings.

Witnesses reported seeing students carrying weapons, including 'ramdas' (large cleavers), during the unrest on campus.

The situation created a volatile atmosphere as both groups gathered in numbers, increasing the risk of further violence.

University authorities and security are monitoring the situation to prevent the escalation of clashes between the rival political student groups.

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV
